name: Zendesk
priceNote: Support Team, per agent, billed yearly (Suite Team with AI agents is $55)

agent.name: Fin
agent.price: $0.99 per outcome (50/mo minimum); Intercom helpdesk from $29/seat/mo
does: Answers tickets across chat, email, WhatsApp and SMS
Runs multi-step procedures like refunds and account updates
Hands off to a human with full context
Learns from your help center and policies

whatYouLose: Fin does not list Zendesk as a supported helpdesk, so in practice you move to Intercom
Costs grow with ticket volume instead of staying flat per seat
You still need people for the tickets Fin cannot finish
notes: Fin resolves a large share of routine tickets by itself. Replacing Zendesk really means switching to Fin on Intercom's own helpdesk.
